identity.description:
Add eval cases by bug injection (D4b R4)

D4b revision R4: eval cases by bug injection.

**Without the pin move and the baseline.** The merge order of the D4b revisions is R1, R4, R2, R3. R1 is not merged yet. When R1 merges, this PR rebases on it, moves the pin in `eval/cases.json` to the merged cases commit, writes `eval/baseline.json` at two repeats, and re-derives the margins by the README rule.

## What changes

- `scripts/inject-case.sh <repo> <base> <head> <patch> <message-file> <name>` makes one injection case. It builds one commit on the merge base of a merged host PR. The commit holds the head tree of the PR with one bug patch applied, and the PR title and body as its message. Then it calls `make-case.sh`, sets the source to `injection`, and keeps the patch as `injection.patch`. So the history, the blame and the PR text of the case do not show the bug. The commit copies the author, the committer and the dates of the host head, so the same inputs give the same sha and the log shows no sign of the injection. The script does not change the host repo, ignores the user's `apply.whitespace` setting, and refuses a message file whose second line is not empty.
- `test/eval-scripts.test.ts`: tests for the script on synthetic repos, a shallow one included.
- `README.md`: a paragraph on the script, and an `injection.patch` row in the case file table.
- `TICKETS.md`: the R4 progress line.

## Cases repo

Branch `d4b-r4-injection` of the cases repo adds four cases, one golden each:

| Case | Language | Host PR size | Kind of bug | Label |
|------|----------|--------------|-------------|-------|
| `injection-websites-130` | TypeScript | ~110 lines | a field key copied from the wrong section | blocking |
| `injection-websites-120` | TypeScript | ~670 lines | a validation check removed from a predicate | suggestion |
| `injection-walle-21` | Python | ~160 lines | the wrong timeout setting on a loop | suggestion |
| `injection-walle-6` | Python | ~1200 lines | an idempotency id minted on each retry | blocking |

The D5 labeling loop chose each label, and the three runs agree for each finding. The cases README gains a section on how to add an injection case. With these cases, the set holds 14 cases and 86 goldens (55 posted).

## Verification

- `npm test` (1307 tests), `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` pass.
- The case loader reads all 14 cases with no error. Each bundle holds exactly one commit from base to head.
- `scripts/check-six-labels.mjs` in the cases repo passes.
